title: Holy Name Cathedral Site, Brisbane
geometryBasis: The standing Holy Name Cathedral sandstone perimeter walls and stone balustrades on Ann Street and the Gotha Street return in Fortitude Valley.
sectionBasis: The eight-point state heritage perimeter is a narrow L-shaped physical fabric strip, independently aligned with Ann and Gotha Street. Current source ground was frozen before constructing the pale arched wall and balustrade.
limitations: The state register controls the scope and real wall strip. The centerline is inferred within that official strip from the two street-facing edges.
The original 1928 CC0 photograph establishes the wall fabric, round recesses, balustrades and masonry piers. Bay count, current infills, wall height and the details of the short return are estimates.
The standing Ann and Gotha Street wall fabric is shown. The modern apartments are outside the physical scope of this site model.
